notes: A card can no longer be filed in a lane that does not exist. When Claude adds a card to your board it sends a track and a status. If either was mistyped - 'Done' instead of 'done', say - Stasys used to quietly change it to the default and report success. Everything looked right: no error, a real card, a clean save. The card was simply in the wrong place, and nothing afterwards could tell you. Stasys now refuses that card and says which lane names the project actually accepts, so the mistake surfaces immediately instead of sitting on your board looking correct. This applies only to cards written through Claude's door. The board itself is unchanged: when you are the one typing, Stasys still tidies up anything odd rather than refusing to save, which is what you want. Also fixed in this version: the advice v0.43 gave Claude for reading error messages in PowerShell did not actually work - it came back blank every time, which was the very problem it was meant to solve. That is corrected, and there is now a test to stop it coming back. Nothing about your existing boards or cards changes.
